tagline: Zeiss Ikon胶片相机，1956 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1956年推出的胶片相机。配备Teronar-Anigstigmat f/3.5。快门速度886/16 Fpms : Novar 3.5/75 mm lens, coated, in a Prontor-SVS shutter 886/16 Lpms : Tessar 3.5/75 mm lens, coated, in a Prontor-SVS shutter。

specs.快门: 886/16 Fpms : Novar 3.5/75 mm lens, coated, in a Prontor-SVS shutter 886/16 Lpms : Tessar 3.5/75 mm lens, coated, in a Prontor-SVS shutter
specs.闪光灯: Sync socket on right side panel. M and X synchronization
specs.英文简介: The Ikoflex Ic (886/16) was made by Zeiss Ikon from 1956 onwards.
